def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # flipper_length_mm is stored as text; parse to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    # negative / out-of-range flipper lengths are invalid -> treat as missing
    bad = (df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235)
    df.loc[bad, 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    # body_mass_g stored as text (with thousands separators); parse to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False), errors='coerce'
    )
    # normalize sex labels; missing stays unknown
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype('object').str.strip().str.lower()
    df.loc[df['sex'] == '', 'sex'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'flipper_length_mm'])
    means = d.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    return {str(k): round(float(v), 2) for k, v in means.items()}
